# **venny**

An R package for generating Venn diagram, summary tables, and ellipse
paths for polygon clipping. It provides direct access to subsets of
interest and offers flexible customization of Venn diagrams. Summary
tables are also available when Venn diagram visualization is not
suitable.

[Get
started](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/articles/venny.html)

There are also other nice alternatives such as
[`ggvenn`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ggvenn),
[`ggVennDiagram`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=ggVennDiagram),
[`UpSetR`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=UpSetR), and other
friends.

# Installation

You can install the package from
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=venny) with:

``` r

install.packages("venny")
```

or the development version from
[GitHub](https://github.com/P10911004-NPUST/venny) with:

``` r

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("P10911004-NPUST/venny")
```

# Quick start

``` r

lst <- LGL23$DEGs
venny(lst)
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`LGL23`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/LGL23.md)
  : RNA-seq data

- [`bits_encoding()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/bits_encoding.md)
  : Create a bits matrix

- [`ellipse_line()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/ellipse_line.md)
  [`ellipse_fill()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/ellipse_line.md)
  : Control the ellipse textures

- [`ellipse_position()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/ellipse_position.md)
  : Ellipse positions

- [`fixed_length()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/fixed_length.md)
  : Fixed Length Vector

- [`generate_ellipse_path()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/generate_ellipse_path.md)
  : Generate Ellipse Path

- [`highlight()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/highlight.md)
  : Draw polygons to highlight subsets

- [`how_many_subsets()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/how_many_subsets.md)
  : How many subsets

- [`set_label_default()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_default.md)
  [`subset_label_default()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_default.md)
  : Set labels

- [`set_label_font()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_font.md)
  [`subset_label_font()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_font.md)
  [`subset_count_font()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_font.md)
  [`subset_percentage_font()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_font.md)
  : Set label font

- [`set_label_position()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_position.md)
  [`subset_label_position()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_position.md)
  [`subset_count_position()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_position.md)
  [`subset_percentage_position()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/set_label_position.md)
  : Set label position

- [`intersect()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/setops.md)
  [`union()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/setops.md)
  [`setdiff()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/setops.md)
  : Set operations

- [`venn_summary()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/venn_summary.md)
  :

  Create a `venny` summary data.frame

- [`venny()`](https://p10911004-npust.github.io/venny/reference/venny.md)
  : Venn diagram
